aetherius.spell.tide_of_renewal.desc: Luna mends the caster and slows everything nearby.
aetherius.spell.stone_bulwark.desc: Terra raises a wall exactly where you are not standing.
aetherius.spell.gale_step.desc: Caelum throws you forward and cushions the landing.
aetherius.spell.void_rend.desc: Nox tears life out of a target and pours part of it into you.
aetherius.spell.solar_flare.desc: Sol + Sol. A close nova of fire and knockback.
aetherius.spell.stormfire.desc: Sol + Caelum. Lightning that sets the ground alight.
aetherius.spell.frost_lance.desc: Luna + Caelum. Freezes movement, then the marrow.
aetherius.spell.rampart.desc: Terra + Terra. A siege wall, five wide and four tall.
aetherius.spell.gravity_well.desc: Nox + Nox. A singularity that pulls enemies into one bad place.
aetherius.spell.mire_of_stars.desc: Terra + Luna. Roots your enemies and shields you.
aetherius.spell.umbral_step.desc: Caelum + Nox. A short blink with a concussive wake.
aetherius.spell.nova_warp.desc: Caelum + Sol + Nox. Blink to your aim, land in a blinding fireburst.
aetherius.spell.starfall_judgement.desc: Sol + Sol + Caelum. Eight meteors fall where you look.
aetherius.spell.aegis_of_tides.desc: Luna + Terra + Terra. A healing shell that punishes melee.
aetherius.spell.eclipse_devour.desc: Nox + Nox + Nox. Mass life-drain. The fastest road to a backfire.
aetherius.spell.skybreak_ascension.desc: Caelum + Caelum + Caelum. Flight, then a lightning crown.
aetherius.spell.forgeheart_transmutation: Terra + Terra + Sol. Turns stone into ore veins.
aetherius.spell.resonant_echo.desc: An unmatched sequence. Each rune gives what it can.

aetherius.chronicle.title: The Chronicle of the Shattered Sky
aetherius.guide.pick: Pick a page on the left.
aetherius.guide.start.title: Getting started
aetherius.guide.start.p1: Press K at any time to open this Chronicle. It does not pause the world, so close it with Esc before a fight.
aetherius.guide.start.p2: The Astral Wand is the tool of the trade: a stick and two Aether Shards in a diagonal shape. Hold it and right-click to cast the runes you have inscribed.
aetherius.guide.start.p3: Aether Shards come from Star-Vein Ore, found under the ground of the Shattered Sky, and from most Aetherius creatures. A Chronicle Tome (book + shard + ink sac) opens this book from your hand.
aetherius.guide.start.p4: Commands, if you play with cheats: /aetherius spells, /aetherius quests, /aetherius rune list, /aetherius mana fill.
aetherius.guide.runes.title: Runes and spells
aetherius.guide.runes.p1: Magic is written in runes. Fifteen of them exist, and every combination of up to three carves out a spell - eighteen spells in all, from light to gravity.
aetherius.guide.runes.p2: Press R to inscribe the next rune you know, Shift+R to clear the line. The HUD by the crosshair shows the line and which spell it will cast.
aetherius.guide.runes.p3: Casting costs mana, which refills on its own. It also builds Astral Tension: past 50 your spells hit twice as hard and cost twice as much, and at 100 the pool backfires. Stop casting and the tension bleeds away.
aetherius.guide.runes.p4: New runes are Chronicle rewards. /aetherius rune list prints what you know; /aetherius rune unlock takes one without cheating the quest that grants it.
aetherius.guide.world.title: The Shattered Sky
aetherius.guide.world.p1: The Shattered Sky is an Aetherius dimension with ordinary, walkable ground: Starlit Meadows, the broken highlands of the Shattered Sky itself, and the Blighted Barrens where the rot has taken hold.
aetherius.guide.world.p2: To get there the honest way, place four Sky-Rift Anchors within twelve blocks of each other and socket a different Elemental Heart into each; the portal opens in the middle of the ring.
aetherius.guide.world.p3: Or use /aetherius dimension to travel, and /aetherius dimension return to come back. You always arrive on solid ground.
aetherius.guide.world.p4: The Barrens spread blight over time; /aetherius blight info reports the current world state. An Aether Altar rite burns it back, and an Aether Fountain refills mana and bleeds off tension.
aetherius.guide.boss.title: The Nox'Thal
aetherius.guide.boss.p1: Nox'Thal, the Star-Eater, circles the arena above the Shattered Sky highlands. It has three phases and the bar at the top of the screen changes colour with each one.
aetherius.guide.boss.p2: In its second phase it cannot be reached in the air: it summons gravity anchors. Destroy every anchor and it is pulled down, and from then on it can be hit.
aetherius.guide.boss.p3: The third phase is the Supernova. The sky goes black and the screen dims to a slot - glowing Rune Lanterns are what you can still see, so place them before the fight.
aetherius.guide.boss.p4: Between phases it shields itself for a few seconds. Do not waste cooldowns on the transition; it is invulnerable until the bar settles into its new colour.
aetherius.guide.craft.title: Forges, altars, lanterns
aetherius.guide.craft.p1: The Aether Forge (shards and lapis around deepslate) is where Aetherius weapons and tools are made; anything the Astral Wand cannot do, the forge can.
aetherius.guide.craft.p2: The Aether Altar runs the purification rite: build the ring it asks for, then right-click it holding two Aether Blood (or one Purified Starlight Elixir). It burns the blight out of the ground around it and leaves you Star-Cleansed.
aetherius.guide.craft.p3: Everything else - the Celestial Pillar, the Telescope, the Astrolabe, the Rune Lantern, the Aether Fountain - is craftable from vanilla materials plus shards. Read the recipe book in the Astral Wand's crafting output.

aetherius.quest.act1_starfall.title: A Light Beneath the Stone
aetherius.quest.act1_starfall.lore: You broke a vein that had no business glowing. For three heartbeats the cavern filled with falling stars, and something very old noticed you noticing it.
aetherius.quest.act1_blood.title: The Blood of Gods
aetherius.quest.act1_blood.lore: The ore weeps when struck. The old texts called it Aether-Blood: what a sky-god leaves behind when it dies above a world it loved.
aetherius.quest.act1_astrolabe.title: An Instrument for the Blind
aetherius.quest.act1_astrolabe.lore: Astrolabes were built to be read at night, by people who had already lost the sky. Build one, and it will point at the temples the gods left behind.
aetherius.quest.act1_observatory.title: The Broken Eye
aetherius.quest.act1_observatory.lore: The Observatories saw the First Convergence coming and chose to watch anyway. Their telescopes are cracked; their lenses are not.
aetherius.quest.act1_herald.title: The Sentinel at the Door
aetherius.quest.act1_herald.lore: Something has been guarding the Observatories since before your language existed. It will not recognise your credentials.
aetherius.quest.act2_sight.title: What the Monocle Shows
aetherius.quest.act2_sight.lore: Wear the Monocle where light cannot lie. The Weave becomes visible - and so does the rot eating it.
aetherius.quest.act2_rot.title: The Rot Has a Name
aetherius.quest.act2_rot.lore: Aspect Corruption. Every void spell you have thrown has been a small incision in the world, and something has been living in the wound.
aetherius.quest.act2_altar.title: A Machine for Forgiving Yourself
aetherius.quest.act2_altar.lore: Five by five by five. Quartz to hold the shape, lapis to remember it, pillars to carry the load, and a core that does not care what you did.
aetherius.quest.act2_purify.title: The First Rite
aetherius.quest.act2_purify.lore: The altar will not erase your choices. It will only stop the grass from turning to ash.
aetherius.quest.act3_hearts.title: Four Keys, Four Wardens
aetherius.quest.act3_hearts.lore: Each Warden has kept a Heart since the sky broke. They were told the Hearts would be needed. They were not told by whom.
aetherius.quest.act3_portal.title: Opening the Horizon
aetherius.quest.act3_portal.lore: Four Hearts, four anchors, one wound. The Sky-Rift is not a door - it is a seam, and you are the needle.
aetherius.quest.act3_arrival.title: The Shattered Sky
aetherius.quest.act3_arrival.lore: Gravity here is a suggestion. Time is a rumour. Below the islands there is no below.
aetherius.quest.act3_anchors.title: Grounding the Unreasonable
aetherius.quest.act3_anchors.lore: Nox'Thal cannot be struck while it is held up by its anchors. Break the anchors and the dragon becomes a thing with weight again.
aetherius.quest.act3_nox.title: The Eclipse Dragon
aetherius.quest.act3_nox.lore: The last sky-god did not shatter at the First Convergence. It hid. It has been eating the light of every world since, waiting for someone to be angry enough to find it.
aetherius.lore.first_convergence.title: The First Convergence
aetherius.lore.first_convergence.body: When the sky-gods fell, they did not fall in one place. They fell in argument. Each one insisted the world below should be remade in their own image, and the argument lasted a hundred years and ended with all of them breaking. Their blood cooled in the dark and became ore; their thoughts cooled into runes. Whatever is left of the argument is still happening, quietly, in the veins under your feet.
aetherius.lore.sky_temples.title: On Sky-Temples
aetherius.lore.sky_temples.body: The Observatories were not places of worship. They were places of record - built so that someone, someday, would know precisely how the sky had broken. Their builders expected to be remembered correctly. The statues were never finished.
aetherius.lore.telescope.title: The Telescope of the Ancients
aetherius.lore.telescope.body: It does not magnify. It reconciles. Pointed at the moon, a working telescope shows what the moon was before the Convergence and will be after - and the lens remembers which runes were invented under each phase.
aetherius.lore.void_sentinels.title: The Sentinels
aetherius.lore.void_sentinels.body: The Sentinels were made to guard the temples from pilgrims. They are 80% immune to things thrown at them, and entirely immune to being told they are obsolete. Their shields are not magic; they are grief with a very good shape.
aetherius.lore.aethersight.title: Aethersight
aetherius.lore.aethersight.body: Wearing the Monocle is uncomfortable. The Weave is not a web of light - it is a web of promises, most of them broken. Look too long and you learn exactly how many immortals have lied to you.
aetherius.lore.celestial_blight.title: Celestial Blight
aetherius.lore.celestial_blight.body: Blight is not poison. It is exposure. Every void cast opens the world a little wider, and something behind the Weave leans in to look. Grass dies first because grass has the least to say for itself. Animals go next, but they come back wrong and angry, wearing the blight as a personality.
aetherius.lore.purification.title: On Purification
aetherius.lore.purification.body: The altar works by offering the world a better alternative to the rot - not by destroying the rot. Star-Ash remembers being grass. Give it one honest day of quartz and lapis and moonlight, and it will remember out loud.
aetherius.lore.elemental_hearts.title: The Elemental Hearts
aetherius.lore.elemental_hearts.body: Four Hearts, one per surviving school of creation. They are not organs. They are opinions so concentrated they became physical: Sol never stopped burning, Luna never stopped pulling, Terra never stopped holding, Caelum never stopped leaving. The Sky-Rift has no opinion. It is therefore indifferent to being asked.
aetherius.lore.shattered_sky.title: The Shattered Sky
aetherius.lore.shattered_sky.body: The Shattered Sky is what is above the world when the sky is not a lie. Islands hold their shape out of habit. Storms come from the future and leave going backwards. Do not trust the horizon; it is a memory that flatters itself.
aetherius.lore.aether_mantas.title: Aether-Mantas
aetherius.lore.aether_mantas.body: The mantas are older than the first attempt at a calendar. They swim through nothing because nothing never told them it was impossible. They are also, perversely, the easiest thing in the Shattered Sky to befriend: they like gentle hands and slow conversation.
aetherius.lore.nox_thal.title: Nox'Thal, the Eclipse Dragon
aetherius.lore.nox_thal.body: Nox'Thal is not the strongest of the fallen. It is the one that learned to eat what it killed instead of mourning it. In its first phase it is a herald - bright, theatrical, immune to anything with a flight arc. In its second phase it takes gravity personally. In its third phase it removes the light, because it has decided the light was the problem.
aetherius.lore.epilogue.title: Epilogue: What Is Left
aetherius.lore.epilogue.body: The Eclipse ends. The sky above the island is still broken, but it is broken in a way that lets light through, and there is a difference. Somewhere a telescope reconciles. Somewhere a sentinel lowers its shield because there is finally nothing to guard against. You have not fixed the world. You have made it answerable - which is all a person with a wand was ever able to do.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.invulnerable: Nox'Thal reshapes, indifferent to your timing.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.anchored: The Gravity Anchors hold the dragon up. Break them.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.anchors_summoned: Four Gravity Anchors chained the air. Destroy them all.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.grounded: The anchors break. Nox'Thal falls into a shape that can bleed.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.supernova: The light is gone. Navigate by rune.
aetherius.boss.nox_thal.anchor_hint: Break the Gravity Anchors to ground the dragon
